description: Add cross-page contextual linking and interconnection. Create a unified 'Related Actions' pattern that connects overlapping features (Questions/Practice/Review/Flashcards/Mistakes) with contextual CTAs and back-navigation paths.
steps: Create src/shared/components/ui/related-actions.tsx - a reusable card component that shows 2-4 contextual action links relevant to the current page. Props: items array of {href, icon, label, description}. Styled as a horizontal row of small cards with hover effects.

Create src/shared/components/ui/page-header.tsx - a standardized page header component with: title, subtitle, optional back button (for nested pages), optional action button (top-right CTA), optional badge (e.g., item count). This replaces the ad-hoc h1/p patterns used across all pages.

Update src/app/(protected)/questions/page.tsx: Add RelatedActions at the bottom linking to: Practice (Spaced repetition), Mistakes (Review errors), Flashcards (Convert weak topics), Insights (View analytics).
Update src/app/(protected)/practice/page.tsx: Add RelatedActions linking to: Questions (Full sessions), Flashcards (Quick review), Review (Smart queue), Formulas (Reference).
Update src/app/(protected)/flashcards/page.tsx: Add RelatedActions linking to: Practice (Spaced rep), Questions (Test yourself), Formulas (Reference cards).
Update src/app/(protected)/mistakes/page.tsx: Add RelatedActions linking to: Practice (Retry weak topics), Questions (New session), Insights (Error patterns).
Update src/app/(protected)/review/page.tsx: Add RelatedActions linking to: Practice (Deep dive), Flashcards (Quick cards), Mistakes (Error patterns).
Update src/app/(protected)/insights/page.tsx: Add RelatedActions linking to: Weekly Report (Summary), Questions (Practice more), Exam Plan (Adjust targets), LOS Tracker (Coverage gaps).

Update the attempt dashboard (src/features/question-bank/components/attempt-dashboard.tsx) to use the PageHeader component with a proper back button that links to /questions/attempts, and add RelatedActions linking to: Practice (Retry weak areas), Mistakes (See all errors), Questions (New session).
acceptance_criteria: Every practice-related page (Questions, Practice, Review, Flashcards, Mistakes) has RelatedActions linking to other related pages
Insights page links to Weekly Report and vice versa (reducing user confusion about overlapping purposes)
Attempt dashboard has a clear back button to /questions/attempts
PageHeader component provides consistent heading pattern across pages
No circular navigation dead-ends - every page has at least 2 contextual exit paths
